jobs_results.title: SDN Network Specialist - Santander Digital Services
jobs_results.description:
Country: Spain

SANTANDER DIGITAL SERVICES is looking for a SDN NETWORK SPECIALIST, based in our Boadilla del Monte (Madrid) office.

WHY YOU SHOULD CONSIDER THIS OPPORTUNITY

At Santander (www.santander.com) we are key players in the transformation of the financial sector. Do you want to join us?

Santander Digital Services (SDS) is the team of technology and operations at Santander. We are convinced of the importance of technology that is aligned with the requirements of the business and that out work not only brings value to users, people and communities but also fosters individual creativity. Our team of over 7,000 people in 8 countries (Spain, Portugal, Poland, UK, USA, Mexico, Chile and Brazil) develops and/or implements financial solutions across a broad spectrum of technologies (including Blockchain, Big Data and Angular among others) on all kinds of on-premise and cloud-based platforms.

Santander is proud of being an organization where there are equal opportunities... regardless of gender identity, culture and disability. Our mission is to contribute to help more people and business prosper. We embrace a strong risk culture and all of our professionals at all levels are expected to take a proactive and responsible approach toward risk management.

What You Will Be Doing

As an SDN Network Specialist you will build out, maintain, and troubleshoot our rapidly expanding infrastructure.

You will be part of a talented team that demonstrates daily superb technical competency, delivering mission critical infrastructure and ensuring the highest levels of availability, performance, and security.

We need somebody like you to help us in all these on-going challenges:
• Manage and monitor all installed systems and infrastructure.
• Install, configure, test and maintain the network infrastructure, DNS, Load balancer, switches, routers, also SDN elements like VMware NSX and different network management tools.
• Perform network maintenance and system upgrades.
• Proactively ensure the highest levels of network and infrastructure availability.
• Monitor and test application performance for potential bottlenecks, identify possible solutions, and work with Support & Engineering Teams to implement those fixes
• Write and maintain custom scripts to increase system efficiency and lower the human intervention time on any tasks
• Participate in the design of information and operational support systems
• Provide 2nd and 3rd level support
• Liaise with vendors and other IT personnel for problem resolution
• Work within established configuration and change management policies to ensure awareness, approval and success of changes made to the network infrastructure.

Experience
• 5+ years’ experience as Network Specialist with main focus in switching and routing.
• Specific experience in the financial sector is a plus.

EDUCATION
• Education System Engineering or other relevant IT degree.

Skills & Knowledge
• Proven hands-on network engineering experience
• Deep knowledge of Arista/Cisco underlay switches.
• Experience with SDN Products (e.g., NSX, CISCO ACI)
• Deep understanding of networking protocols (e.g., Leaf & Spine Topology, IPSEC, HSRP, BGP, OSPF, 802.11, QoS, VXLAN, EVPN).
• Solid understanding of the OSI or TCP/IP model.
• Hands-on experience with monitoring, network diagnostic and network analytics tools. Monitoring Tools (Netscout, CA Spectum, VMware VRNI, Arista Cloud Vision Portal).
• Load balancer – F5, AVI.
• DNS - Infoblox, bind.
• Public Cloud experience preferably in AWS and MS Azure is a plus.
• Solid scripting skills (e.g., Shell scripts, Python, Power Shell,).
• Cloud architectures (vCloud, Azure/AWS).
• Automation (AVD, Ansible).
• Experience in Agile Methodology and Tools (Kanban, JIRA, Confluence…).

OTRA INFORMACIÓN
• Availability to perform punctual network maintenance work after hours.
• Performing the On-Call support. Monthly rotation.

If you want to know more about us, visit our website:

https://www.santanderdigitalservices.com/es/home

https://www.betechwithsantander.com/en/home

jobs_results.title: Researcher in network virtualization (SDN/NFV)
jobs_results.description:
We are looking for a researcher with research experience in the field of network virtualization to join our headquarters in San Sebastian or Bilbao. Vicomtech is an applied research technology center, dynamic, innovative and leading in the field of 5G and 6G communications with projects such as Open-Verse (https://www.openverso.org/), 6G-XR (https://www.6g-xr.eu/), 5GMETA (https://5gmeta-project.eu/) or 5G-EUSKADI (https://5g-euskadi.com/).

The selected person will join a team of 20 people with multidisciplinary knowledge within the Digital Media & Communications department. The research staff at Vicomtech has creative freedom when conducting research, looking for creative solutions to scientific-technological challenges, so we are looking for a proactive and autonomous person who likes to train and address new challenges. For this, we offer opportunities in the training and education of people, defining from the beginning a career and professional progression. In addition, Vicomtech... has policies of conciliation, to achieve a balance between work and family life, remote work and equal employment opportunities.

Applicants must have:
• Education: Engineering or Degree in Computer Science or Telecommunications. A Master's Degree in the field of telecommunications or computer science will be an asset.
• Experience in software development, Linux operating system, code development tools (GIT). In addition, it will be valued to be able to accredit work experience with OpenStack, Kubernetes and Open Source Mano.
• Knowledge in the field of Cloud Computing and Multi-access Edge Computing (MEC), familiar with virtualization solutions and network orchestration (NFV).
• Languages: Spanish and English.

Although it is not an indispensable requirement, it will be valued that the candidate is author or co-author of scientific articles in international congresses or scientific journals of international relevance. In any case, it is required that he/she has the motivation to develop his/her ability to read and write scientific articles, in order to publish the results of Vicomtech's research projects.

If you feel identified with us, please send us your CV

jobs_results.title: Técnico/a Redes SDN/SD-WAN (90% Remoto)
jobs_results.description:
Debido a la expansión de Alcorce Telecomunicaciones S.L. precisamos cubrir una posición de Técnico/a de Redes SDN/SD-WAN para trabajar en modalidad 90 remoto en los servicios que prestamos a un importante cliente del sector TIC en Madrid.

Funciones

Realizar actividad propia de Ingeniería LAN y SDN como puedan ser control obsolescencia creación de planta actualizaciones SW y HW control de direccionamiento control de la capacidad de la planta gestión de herramientas de capacidad etc.

Requisitos

Al menos 2-3 años de experiencia en comunicaciones y gestión de proyectos de comunicaciones.

Se ofrece

Proyecto Estable.

Zona de trabajo Madrid. 90 Remoto.
